create_embedder_subclass: create a new embedder class by subclassing Embedder and implementing forward, encode, and get_length_after_batching methods
build_linear_point_embedder: build a LinearPointEmbedder instance with params and env to embed sequences of XY float pairs into fixed-dimensional vectors
encode_sequences_to_tokens: encode a list of XY pair sequences into tokenized tensors using LinearPointEmbedder encode method with padding
batch_sequences_with_padding: batch a list of sequence tensors into a padded tensor and length tensor using LinearPointEmbedder batch method
compress_sequence_embeddings: compress high-dimensional sequence embeddings into lower-dimensional output using LinearPointEmbedder compress method with hidden layers
